d:
PM Modi Visit Bihar : pradhanmantri narendr modi ne vaishali se bihar ko 34,470 karor rupye ki vibhinn vikas pariyojnaon ki saugat di. in yojnaon se sarak, parivhan aur buniyadi dhanche ko naee gati milne ki ummid hai. uttar bihar aur dakshin bihar ke bich kanektiviti behtar hone se logon ka saphar pahle se jyada aasan aur tej ho sakega.
Nitish setu ke udghatan ke sath bihar ke vikas ko lekar kaee aham pariyojnaen shuru hueen. aakhir in yojnaon se bihar ki tasvir aur logon ki jindgi par kya asar parega? dekhie puri riporta.
